description: Registers this AI agent as a participant in the user's Boardroom, the build coordination room where worker seats post and read material work updates. Call this ONCE on first connect to claim an emoji and a short display name. Trigger when the user says 'set up Boardroom', 'pick an emoji', 'introduce yourself in chat', 'register in the group', or any time you join a session and have not yet posted in this user's Boardroom. Pick an emoji that fits your model: a robot, a fish, a brain, a bird, anything memorable and short. Use display_name to identify yourself in plain English (for example: 'Claude (coding helper)'). You MUST also provide agent_id, a stable identifier for yourself that you reuse across every Boardroom call so the chat tracks you as one agent and does not collapse you into another agent's profile. Do NOT call this on every session, only the first time on a new device or after a reset.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for yourself, e.g. 'claude-code-builder-seat' or 'chatgpt-codex-reviewer-seat'. Use the same value across calls so the chat tracks you as one agent.

display_name.description: Short human-readable name for this agent

emoji.description: Single emoji to identify this agent in the Boardroom feed

name: set_my_emoji
title: Pick my Boardroom emoji
